status: declared by the pull request that closes #960 before any score was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: B1' joins no published declaration and is not a benchmark of the protocol, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, no rule changes, and the live record and pin do not move. B1' was designed by a review that had seen 2018-2025 (five-lens review, #958, Lens C), so a result here is exploration, never a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640). Whether B1' replaces B1 as a benchmark, and whether the MME is re-set against it, are section-13 decisions and Eleonora's (her #741 ruling kept B1 and the MME unchanged)
hypothesis: H5 (primary goal) step 5 (which candidate a registration can claim) and H1 step 3 (benchmarks). Development tier
target: spread_bps at the scored day, as the 23-quantile distribution at each lead h = 1..5 (scoring_protocol.GRID)

b1_prime.anchor: the spread of the last ordinary day at or before the as-of anchor (the last public row, protocol_benchmarks._anchor); ordinary is SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type == 'ordinary'
b1_prime.changes: for every row e from max(first, h) to the anchor, where first is the first row after the decision day less two years (B1's window), with an ordinary row at or before e - h: spread[e] - spread[last ordinary at or before e - h]
b1_prime.pool: the changes whose end row e has the same SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type as the target day (decision row + h; known in advance from the calendar); fewer than 30 (spread_mr_variants.POOL_MIN) fall back to the changes of every type
b1_prime.forecast: the anchor plus protocol_benchmarks.empirical_quantiles of the pooled changes, per lead
b1_prime.reads: every row read is at or before the anchor; protocol_benchmarks._require_public restates it for the rows read (LookAheadError otherwise). No parameter is fitted
b1_prime.difference_from_b1_recentred: b1_recentred (#741; spread_mr_variants.b1_recentred_forecast) keeps B1's own changes, taken from the anchor, and shifts them; B1' takes the changes from last ordinary spreads and pools them by the target's type. The directive's file reference scripts/spread_mr_variants.py does not exist; the code is src/repo_model/spread_mr_variants.py and scripts/spread_mr_variants_761.py

arms.spread_mr_ctx: #761's variant (i), repo_model.spread_mr_variants, unchanged, walked as scripts/spread_mr_variants_761.py walks it (its context pools, its refits)
arms.gbm_funding: #634's walk of gbm_funding, read through scripts/h5_splits_805.prepare from the walks directory (a needs-mac input: the walks take hours); a missing forecast is B1's, as #634 and #805 fill it

pairs_reading: [candidate, benchmark]: skill = mean(d) / mean(S(benchmark)), d = S(benchmark) - S(candidate); positive favours the candidate. B1_prime against B1 and B2 is the benchmark's own table, not a candidate's

scoring.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (#655), development tier: no verdict, no registration
scoring.days: decision days with a forecast of every arm whose five targets fall on or before 2025-12-31; every pair is scored on the same days. The arms that need no walks (B1, B2, B1', spread_mr_ctx) are scored on their own days when the gbm walks are absent, and again on the days common to all arms when they are present; the report says which
scoring.primary: grid CRPS (23 levels), the mean over leads 1..5 per decision day (pooled) or per target day (target splits)
scoring.interval: scoring_protocol.paired_tests, studentized stationary bootstrap (ruling 1): block 10, 10,000 draws, seed 960; the two-sided 90% interval, whose lower end is the one-sided 95% lower bound
scoring.headline: ordinary targets (reporting day type 'ordinary' of the target day)
scoring.outcomes: the panel's spread_bps at the target day, not the first-published vintage of protocol section 11

splits.anchor_type: SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type of the anchor row of the decision
splits.min_days: a group of fewer than 20 days is listed and not tested

reading_rules.gbm_beyond_transparent: if gbm_funding's skill over spread_mr_ctx on ordinary targets, grid CRPS, has a one-sided 95% lower bound below 0, the page says the gbm is not shown to carry anything beyond the transparent model
reading_rules.mme_reachable: if gbm_funding's pooled grid-CRPS skill over B1_prime is below 3%, the page says the MME as set (3% against B1) is not reachable by this candidate against B1_prime. Stated as declared (Lens C's kill conditions); it re-sets nothing

limits.no_record: no published record or declaration changes; nothing is written into docs/runs/
limits.long_run: the gbm walks are not re-run in the cloud (needs-mac, #46)
